body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Toshiba(www.toshiba.com) introduced SSD 'MKxx01GRZB' at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
'MKxx01GRZB' is SSD for enterprise with 2.5-inch SLC which is faster compared to MLC. Capacity is 100 / 200 / 400GB.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
